## Design Decision

* [CMS PDF memory: lossless knot storage first, up to 2× time, aim below 1.5 GB, guarded in CI](D1-lossless-knots-first.md) - Members are stored as their knots with the cubic built on use, bit-identical to today's interpolation; generate may slow by up to 2× on the CMS request; the target is below 1.5 GB peak; a default test pins bytes per loaded member.
